title: Neutron origins of a 248 keV single scatter: spectra, multiplicity and what the 2.84 t yr already exclude
question: Which neutron sources can give a 248 keV xenon recoil, what recoil spectrum and low-energy companion population accompany one such single scatter, and how many single-site 200-270 keV recoils do (alpha,n), 238U spontaneous fission and muon-induced neutrons predict given LZ's own constraints (detector NR <= 0.118, fission <= 1% of (alpha,n), muon UL 4.6e-4)?
headline_result: Neutrons cannot explain the event: 19F(alpha,n), LZ's dominant neutron source, ends at 6.31 MeV (E_R,max 191 keV) and only trace 13C/17O/B reactions, 238U fission (0.5% above 8.2 MeV) and muon-induced neutrons reach the 8.20 MeV threshold; a transport MC with a black-disk angular pattern and LZ's own normalisations gives 6.6e-6 expected neutron single scatters in 200-270 keV (<= 5e-4 with every conservative choice stacked), and one such (alpha,n) event would imply ~2e4 low-energy single scatters and ~2e5 delayed-veto NR events (55 observed).
key_numbers: E_n,min(248)=8.20 MeV (7.74-8.48 per isotope), q=1.248 fm^-1; 19F endpoints 5.26/6.31 MeV; 13C 9.53/10.56, 17O 7.90/8.94, 10B 8.20/9.21 MeV; PTFE share above 8.2 MeV (4-6)e-4, f_C=2.5e-3 adopted; black-disk R=6.35 fm zeros 58/194/408/700 keV, f(200-270)=1.05e-2 at 10 MeV (iso 0.231), 9.9e-3 at 200 MeV; Watt mean 2.03 MeV, f(>8.2)=5.2e-3; lambda_tot(10 MeV)=14.2 cm; P(clean SS in FV|deposit)=0.6-1.4%; F(200-270|ROI SS)=5.1e-5 (a,n), 1.9e-4 SF, 2.2-3.5e-2 muon (1.3-2.0e-3 of all SS); companions <55 keV per window event 1.9e4/5.1e3/24-40; N(200-270): (a,n) 6.0e-6 (0.118), 1.0e-6 (0.02), 1.6e-4 (<=3 low-E); SF 9e-11 (silent 3.8e-4), 2.4e-7 without; muon 0.6-1.6e-5; total central 6.6e-6, stacked-conservative 5.1e-4; hybrids 248+39.6 keV -> (745 phd, 4.54); at S1c=540 +15/+22 sigma vs event -1.8 sigma
model_or_mechanism: two-body (alpha,n) and n-Xe elastic kinematics E_R=q^2/2M; sharp-cutoff black-disk |2J1(qR)/qR|^2 angular pattern (isotropic as upper bound); Watt 238U SF, E^-1/E^-2 muon spectra; vectorised MC transport in a 72.8x145.6 cm LXe cylinder with recalled sigma_el/sigma_nonel; SS = exactly one deposit >3 keV in active volume inside FV; fission silent-companion generating function; NEST-LZ yields for (n,n'gamma) hybrids
stance: neutral (constraint: neutrons of any origin disfavoured at P <~ 5e-4, central 7e-6; does not discriminate DM from accidentals, RFR MSSI or artifacts)
result_type: computed (kinematics, MC fractions, hybrid loci) / estimated (source fractions, cross sections, silent factor)
confidence: medium - conclusion robust by 3-5 orders of magnitude under every variant, but cross sections, (alpha,n) high-energy share, fission multiplicity and muon spectrum are recalled and the muon channel rests on LZ's simulated UL
